note: Harr's missions. Each one is checked only against facts the game server or NemoWorld recorded for that player: signed events, an acknowledged pantry delivery, the practice quest, or the account link. Practice missions award nothing; nothing here gives coins, items or power. Text stays in the vocabulary of care, study, building and gratitude.

missions.title: Meet five villagers
missions.purpose: Knowing your neighbours is the first step to working with them.
missions.how: Walk up to the people around the plaza, the workshop and the fields and stand beside them for a moment.

missions.title: Share a meal
missions.purpose: The pantry is free for everyone; a shared meal is the simplest kind of welcome.
missions.how: Whisper Selene: take apple. The pantry is free for everyone.

missions.title: Find a place for the library
missions.purpose: Every place recorded is a page the whole village can read.
missions.how: Whisper Selene: library, then walk to {place} and stay a few seconds.

missions.title: Lend a hand to the builders
missions.purpose: A stage is built only while a crew stands at the site; a visitor can be part of that crew.
missions.how: Whisper Selene: works. When a stage waits for a crew, stand with the builders at its site until it is built; the village records who helped.

missions.title: Take the Quiet Survey with Lyra
missions.purpose: Walking a survey with a scholar is how a practice becomes a record.
missions.how: Stand beside Lyra at the house; she will walk the field survey with you. It is a practice and awards nothing.

missions.title: Keep your progress in NemoWorld
missions.purpose: A linked character lets the village remember what you did, not only what you said.
missions.how: Whisper Lyra: link my account. She sends a private code to enter on the NemoWorld link page.

missions.title: Add three pages to the library
missions.purpose: Every find adds insight for the whole village and brings the next technology closer.
missions.how: Whisper Selene: library for hints. Three different places is enough.

missions.title: Walk with a villager to a place
missions.purpose: The village grows by doing things together, not by watching.
missions.how: Stand beside a resident inside a landmark for a few seconds; the game records that you were there together.
